summary: Supplier longlist screened against qualification criteria. Shortlist produced with pass/fail rationale for each candidate.
assumptions: Qualification criteria reflect actual stakeholder priorities
Longlist is a reasonable starting set and has not been curated to favour a specific outcome
Evidence provided per candidate is accurate and current
data_gaps: Third-party compliance certifications not independently verified
Financial health data unavailable for two candidates — provisional pass applied pending review
risk_flags: Shortlist contains fewer than three candidates — competition may be insufficient
One borderline candidate retained — decision authority should review rationale before proceeding
open_questions: Should the borderline candidate be passed or failed given the available evidence?
Are there additional disqualifiers not captured in the criteria provided?
next_action: Confirm shortlist with stakeholders before issuing RFx.
reasoning_trace: Mandatory disqualifiers were applied first, then weighted criteria were used for pass-through candidates; borderline evidence gaps were surfaced rather than silently converted into pass/fail decisions.

concentration_risk_flags: Shortlist contains fewer than three robustly evidenced candidates

flags: Borderline candidate requires decision authority confirmation
assumptions_to_carry_forward: Candidate-provided evidence remains valid at time of RFx issue
